build.title: lib-mcp: MCP client library for every AXF app

said.text: Framework library (web + Android, later Python) so any AXF app can be an MCP client: server registry, Streamable HTTP, browse tools/resources/prompts, call tools under the kernel interop exposure rules, tokens in secure storage. Reference: the console MCP client plugin (apps/console-web/plugins/mcp-client).
